findings.one_line: The left-hand object R_n^e(d,kappa,beta,gamma,L) omits alpha although its defining supremum is over P(d,kappa,alpha,beta,gamma,L), so the declared oracle-risk functional is not single-valued as written.

The reproduced oracle proof uses the propensity shape/envelope, contrast Holder condition, response model, and range bounds, but never multiplier-Holder or control-Holder smoothness; it proves the same rate on the broader oracle class without those clauses.
